text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooooah...!??)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Air Shakur...!
Mowing down everyone above and below?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
This year's main star is... Air Shakur?!
S-Seriously...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... that was an amazing run.
Air Shakur... is seriously incredible..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
All I could see was Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see. So this is the world you've drawn. Perhaps I should take back what I said about it being too beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur...
had a look in her eyes I've never seen before."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What's out there...?
I just...—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...Tachyon. Perhaps I shouldn't have come today?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? All I can say is, whether you came today or not,
your path has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And she seized it.
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...
Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nice.
Make more noise, keep screaming.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Burn me into your memory.
That is the only thing you are permitted to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur suddenly
placed a hand over her chest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
âDid you see that?
Can you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's your loss.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur remains silent.
Yet, the message in her eyes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already knew how to understand
what she wanted to convey.
